text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Cyber Resilience Act – Regulation (EU) 2024/2847

Procedure 2022/0272(COD). Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); the route this act took is highlighted. Lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see cra.html).
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading.
Council working party (examination of the proposal)
technical work on the final text

• The Council vote approving the EP position (Art. 294(4) TFEU) took place after the I/A item note of 27 Sep 2024 and before the signature on 23 Oct 2024; its exact date is not in the sources used.

• Trilogues and the Coreper letter are informal steps, not part of Art. 294 TFEU; they follow the Joint Declaration on practical arrangements for the codecision procedure (OJ C 145, 30.6.2007, p. 5), points 7–14.
